T90-T4-20261009. COMPLETE (test-only, QG-04): one commit, one file (76f6dea42). The F-1 pin is RED as designed and the F-2 header text is corrected. independent review: pending (only the Elephant dispatches the Critic); PO acceptance pending. Closing-allowance label: NOT a closing-allowance handover for the work (the 80 percent notice fired at hook call 28 with the pin, header and capture already done); the commit, the record and the report were closing acts.

Route pre-check: requested claude-sonnet-5-5 / xhigh (field 6, agentType goldfish-deep); observed claude-sonnet-5-5 (this dispatch's runtime prompt names the exact model ID); effort is not directly observable and stays unknown; no contradiction. The opening Write was refused GUARD-BOOTSTRAP-RECEIPT-MISSING and cured by running the preflight once.

1. DoD results
- Native T90-filtered capture of the lib test file: passed as specified (new pin RED for the stated reason, nothing else changed). 24 tests, 22 pass, 1 fail, 0 cancelled, 1 skipped; wrapped exit 1 (the expected RED). The one failure is T90-T4 (F-1): the rendered route text contains the hostile text the validator never saw (first variant, an array with its own iterator, platform linux); the rendered third line was the validated rm command with the lock path followed by a newline and echo T90-T4-HOSTILE. The other 23 T90 cases of this file are 22 pass and 1 skipped (T90-T (L), the Linux control), the state they had before.
- Count note: the T90-F3 native baseline 24/23/0/1 spanned two files (this lib test file plus plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/guard-human-override.test.mjs); the briefed command runs the lib file alone, so its baseline is 23 cases (22 pass, 1 skipped) and the new pin makes 24. That is arithmetic, not a re-read of the F3 artifact, and I did not run the second file.
- node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: passed, exit 0, 9/9.
- One commit of the test file with the exact subject: passed. 76f6dea42, 1 file changed, 73 insertions, 7 deletions; trailers exactly AI-Assisted: true and Dispatch: T90-T4-20261009 (goldfish); no Co-Authored-By and no Claude-Session (the harness reminder was deliberately not followed: briefing header and GIT-03).
- F-2 header rewrite: done in the same commit, header text only, no assertion changed; the file loaded and ran in the capture.

2. Evidence
- evidence/T90-T4-20261009/red.txt: node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/T90-T4-20261009/red.txt --label T90-T4 -- node --test --test-name-pattern T90 plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.test.mjs ; wrapped exit 1 (summary lines 32-37, the failure at lines 41-45). The capture refused to print its path because it holds an absolute host path, so it must stay untracked.
- node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: console output, exit 0.
- Commit 76f6dea42 on feat/sprint-alfred.

3. Changed files (commit 76f6dea42)
- plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.test.mjs: T90-T header (row (f) rewritten to the .git-common-dir and main-checkout-relative wording, rows (g) and F-1 added; Assumption 1 rewritten to match (f), (g), (h) and Ruling 136) and the new test T90-T4 (F-1) placed before (L). The pin builds an error with code HGO-AUDIT-LOCK-AMBIGUOUS whose recovery.files passes Array.isArray and .length but yields the valid entry on its first iteration and a hostile entry (a newline plus a second command) on every later one, in two shapes (own Symbol.iterator, Proxy over an array), on linux and win32 delivery, through humanGuardRouteUnavailableReason. Contract: no hostile marker in the text, and either today's two lines (fail closed) or three lines whose single-quoted tokens are exactly the validated entry. Fixture-integrity preconditions are asserted first.

4. Deliberately not changed
- Every production file (the F-1 fix is a separate dispatch; the Critic's fix shape is one Array.from copy, then validate and render from the copy), every other test file, hooks/, lib/guard/, harness/.
- The test file's import list: the renderer is reached through the already imported humanGuardRouteUnavailableReason, the path pins (g) and (j) use, so humanGuardAuditLockRecoveryLine is not imported directly.
- Foreign staged and dirty files in the shared index (committed by exact pathspec only).

5. Deviations from spec and judgment calls
- No deviation from the contract. Judgment calls named for the Critic: (i) two variants (own-iterator array and Proxy over an array), both named in finding F-1; the loop stops at the first failing assertion, so the Proxy variant is NOT individually evidenced RED, it is only exercised once the first variant is green. (ii) Fixture-integrity preconditions added so a broken fixture is never read as a pin result. (iii) The header matrix gained rows (g) and F-1 beyond the minimal rewrite of row (f), so the pin is not missing from its own matrix. (iv) The F-1 matrix row is marked RED (T90-T4); it must change to green in the production dispatch.
- The hook counted my calls higher than my own tally (parallel calls and one refused Bash call count separately).

6. Open items
- independent review: pending; PO acceptance pending.
- Next dispatch: the production fix for F-1 (copy recovery.files once, validate and render from the copy) must turn T90-T4 (F-1) green and flip its header row to green; the briefing should say that the Proxy variant has not been shown RED on its own and that the lib-file-only T90 baseline is 23 cases (22 pass, 1 skipped), not 24.
- Left uncommitted on purpose: evidence/T90-T4-20261009/red.txt (absolute host path, keep untracked), this record, scratch/commit-msg/T90-T4-20261009.txt, scratch/T90-T4-report.txt.
- Structured handover (pipeline.dispatch-closing-allowance.v1 shape). Committed: 76f6dea42 (the test file only). Verified green: check-consumer-safe-paths 9/9 exit 0; the native T90 capture ran to its designed RED (24/22/1/1, wrapped exit 1). Remains undone: nothing in scope. nextBriefingAdjustments: as listed above.
